title: WorldCom: $3.8 Billion in Hidden Costs — The Bernie Ebbers Paper Trail
summary: At his 2005 trial, WorldCom's former CEO Bernard Ebbers said he began throwing a key monthly expense report in the trash without reading it. Built from the government's Supreme Court brief, the Second Circuit's opinion, the trial judge's order, the Justice Department's Corporate Fraud Task Force report, the SEC's complaint, the congressional record and the 2019 compassionate-release filings, this is the paper trail: "we have to hit our numbers," about $3.8 billion in line costs booked as capital, the internal audit that found it, the guilty verdict on all nine counts, the 25-year sentence — and what happened after.
